(i) we propose a new framework for hybrid physical-statistical models that is general, well-posed, and theoretically justified, and that (ii) we demonstrate that this framework is able to outperform existing approaches in several dynamical systems.

(a) we provide a general framework to combine physical and statistical models for dynamical systems identification and prediction, (b) this framework generalizes several hybrid schemes proposed in previous works and (c) we show that our framework leads to better predictions than the individual physical and statistical models.
